description: The bar chart illustrates the average number of likes (“Avg. Like #”) associated with five “Most similar group of posts” categories shown as angle-interval bins. The categories are on the horizontal axis, labeled “Most similar group of posts,” and appear in increasing interval order: (0,90], (90,180], (180,270], (270,360], and (360,450]. The vertical axis is labeled “Avg. Like #” and uses a linear numeric scale with labeled ticks at 400, 450, 500, 550, and 600 (50-unit intervals), with the plotted range extending slightly above 600 to accommodate error bars. Each category is represented by a single light-blue vertical bar with a thin dark outline and a black vertical error bar with caps: (0,90] is approximately 600 likes; (90,180] is approximately 565–570 likes; (180,270] is approximately 570–575 likes; (270,360] is approximately 590–595 likes; and (360,450] is approximately 585–590 likes. The error bars vary in length, with the (360,450] and (270,360] bars showing visibly larger uncertainty ranges than the others. The bars are not sorted by height; they follow the interval order, and no bar is uniquely highlighted beyond the uniform styling and the presence of error bars.
